name: User Menu
author: Tanner Burns
description: Your username in the bar. Click for session details, the third-party accounts signed in on this machine, SSH/GPG/keyring/fingerprint status, and lock or log out.

barWidget.description: Username, full name, or hostname in the bar. Left click opens the user menu, right click cycles the label, middle click refreshes.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the bar shows. 'none' shows only the icon. Vertical bars always show the icon or initials.

schema.label: Show user icon
schema.description: Prefix the label with an account glyph. With the icon off, vertical bars show initials.

schema.label: Hidden providers
schema.description: Comma-separated provider ids to hide, e.g. 'docker,steam'. Ids: git, github, gitlab, google, gemini, microsoft, claude, openai, copilot, cursor, opencode, huggingface, aws, azure, vercel, netlify, cloudflare, fly, heroku, firebase, supabase, npm, terraform, docker, tailscale, slack, spotify, steam, dropbox, nextcloud, 1password, bitwarden.

schema.label: Show signed-out accounts
schema.description: List tools that are configured on this machine but not signed in.

schema.label: Confirm log out
schema.description: Ask before logging out from the menu.
